name: Café Rio House Creamy Tomatillo Ranch Dressing (Warning)
brandOrRestaurant: Café Rio Mexican Grill (Utah County / Salt Lake)
whyItWorks: Famous house dressing made by blending heavy mayonnaise, buttermilk, sour cream, raw jalapenos, cilantro, and garlic. The concentrated dairy fat and raw alliums/capsaicin frequently spark acute flare reactions.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Dairy & Spice Warning: Avoid during flares. If in solid remission, ask for it on the side and use a light fork dip.
